messages:
ops-scheduler: Heads-up — telemetry-driven firmware sweep tonight 01:00-03:00 UTC for az3 racks. Plan: rolling softflip of NIC fw and GPU microcode, 1 rack at a time. We’ll warm backfill from eu pools before evicting pods. Expect transient latency spike and ~5% capacity dip. Reply with blockers or :thumbsup: by EOD.

kevin: Ack. Can we limit concurrent racks to 1 every 20m? last run caused a short egress jitter. :eyes:

ops-scheduler: Yup, 20m per rack, stagger by AZ-subnet. Targeting low-traffic window per telemetry heatmap.

marina: Oncall here — I’ll be watching latency dashboards and can pause if error budget trends up. How do we roll back if a fw flip misbehaves?

ash: Rollback is firmware re-flash to previous image; ops-scheduler will trigger an automated revert playbook. We also have an automatic model-routing fallback to eu-west when latency > 300ms for 3 consecutive mins.

ops-scheduler: Revert playbook snippet:

```sh
# example revert command
./revert-fw --rack $RACK --component nic --image v1.2.3
```

sanjay: Capacity note — az3 is currently at 78% GPU utilization. With 1-rack drain we’ll see ~4-6% headroom loss; eu backfill should cover most queued work but expect short queueing for bursty tenants. Cost impact estimate ~+$250 for 2h if we hit peak backfill.

kevin: Could we pre-warm KV prefix caches in eu to reduce cold-start token cost?

ash: Yes — ops-scheduler will trigger prefix cache warmup after each rack finishes. Command snippet: `./warm-prefixes --regions eu-west1 --prefix-file warmlist.txt`

ops-scheduler: Communication plan: incident-bot will post start/finish per rack in #eng-infra and #support. We’ll tag any affected customer routes and create temporary rate-limit relax policy if needed.

deploy-bot: Scheduled job created: fw-sweep-1701205678, window 2024-11-28 01:00-03:00 UTC, stagger=20m, mode=softflip.

marina: Quick checklist for night ops: monitoring links, rollback contacts, throttles, and post-op perf tests. I’ll push checklist to the runbook.

kevin: One more ask — please exclude priority-tenant pools (tenant-id:tier-enterprise) from draining automatically. Ops-scheduler: can you add that filter?

ops-scheduler: Good call. Adding exclude filter `--exclude-pool tier-enterprise`. Updated job config saved.

sanjay: Noted re cost. I’ll post a short post-mortem with capacity/cost delta if we cross the $300 threshold.

ops-scheduler: Thanks everyone. If no more blockers, proceed. I’ll post final confirmation 30m before start. :white_check_mark:
